rationale: FX01 fires only when non-USD debt principal lacks an explicit USD principal. A targeted source search found no foreign-currency/CAD/EUR/GBP context. The missing principal_amount_usd therefore reflects a check/scope issue for USD source principal, not a data error requiring FX conversion.
